texts.zh:
这种噪音——听起来杂糅着恐怖的轰鸣声和金属刮擦的声音——喧嚣了数秒钟，又以一声兀然的嚎叫般的噪音结尾，让在场的所有人都打了个寒颤。

正当[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]觉得这可怕的声音沉寂下去以后，它们又变本加厉地开始了。[This.Leader.GetSheHe]强忍着不适关闭了接收器。[This.Leader.GetSheHeCap]转向了聚在一起的官员们，他们中的一些甚至吓得躲到了椅背后面。
“豁，好家伙……”[This.Leader.GetSheHe]无力地说。

很难想象我们从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的这个物种发出的这些噪音没有敌意。海军官员已经做出来最坏的预计，认为我们很快就会与之交战，更冷静的声音则说我们需要再耐心地等待观察。
texts.en:
The noises - a mixture of threatening booming noises and what sounds like the grinding of metal on metal - continued unabated for several minutes, punctuated occasionally by a howling noise that sent a chill through everyone who heard it.

Just as [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] thought the noises had died down, they started up again, louder than before. With a wince, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] switched the receiver off. [This.Leader.GetSheHeCap] turned to the gathered crowd of officers, some of whom were cowering behind their seats.
"Well, that was quite something..." [This.Leader.GetSheHe] said weakly.

It is hard to imagine that a species making the noises we have picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] could be anything other than hostile. Naval officers already fear the worst and assume we will soon be at war with them, but calmer heads suggest we'd be better off waiting and seeing.

label.zh: 他们并不能决定自己发出什么样的声音。我们之后会去理解他们的。
label.en: They cannot help how they sound. We will come to understand them later.

label.zh: 这是挑衅。我们也让他们听点噪音！
label.en: It is a challenge. Send threatening noises back!

texts.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出应为侵犯性的手势，至少我们如此理解……

一些观察者怀疑，他们有可能出于某种目的正在试图蓄意制造事故。然而其他人指出他们并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动，并敦促我们在弄明白他们的意图之前不要过早地下定结论。
texts.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] hypothesize - making gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that seem rather aggressive, to us at least...

Some observers suspect that they may be attempting to deliberately provoke an incident for reasons unknown. Others, however, point out that they have yet to make any outright hostile moves, and urge us not to jump to conclusions before we know more of their intentions.

texts.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们只能猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出奇怪的手势，似乎表明了制造伤害的意图……

我们确定他们为是否在试图蓄意制造事故，若如此他们为何并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动。
texts.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, we can only assume - making odd gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that would seem intent on causing harm...

We are unsure whether they intend to provoke an incident, and if so, why they haven't made any outright hostile moves yet.

label.en: Mimic their greeting back to them.

texts.zh: 显然，我们的回应不合时宜：[contact_country.GetName]的反应快速而充满敌意，他们开始向我们的舰船开火。似乎我们必须依靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]来回敬他们了。
texts.en: Clearly, our response was not the appropriate one: the response of the [contact_country.GetName] was swift and hostile, as they began firing on our ships. It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

texts.zh: 我们实在不知道搞错了什么，[contact_country.GetName]突然就向我们发起了攻击！看来我们必须靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]回敬他们了！
texts.en: It is not clear what went wrong, but the [contact_country.GetName] are suddenly attacking us! It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!
